title: observability: token-level + kv-cache cost/latency dashboard and alert refinements
author: Maya Patel
description: Context: Ongoing work to provide token-level cost/latency breakdowns and KV-cache observability for production workloads. Motivation: reduce noisy alerts, give SREs and platform teams visibility into per-token cost regressions and KV-cache effectiveness (hit/miss/tolling), and tie tracing to token-level spans for request correlation. This PR includes: 1) New Grafana dashboard JSON that breaks down per-request token cost/latency (encoding cost model + hardware unit cost), KV-cache hit/miss ratios, per-model token percentiles, and per-route cost attribution. 2) Alert tuning: update of alert thresholds and alert conditions to use p95/p99 token-latency and sustained cost increase windows to reduce false positives. 3) Tracing: add token-level span annotations for long tail latency (sampling only for p99 to limit cardinality). 4) Logging: include request_id and route/model tags in relevant log lines for telemetry. 5) Tests and integration harness updates for the dashboard metrics. Related: ENG-3245 (token-level cost observability), ENG-3350 (kv-cache metrics), SUP-1123 (support ticket investigating noisy cost alerts). Checklist: - [x] Metrics instrumentation for KV cache (hits, misses, bypass) - [x] Token-level cost and latency counters/gauges - [x] Grafana dashboard + panels + templating - [x] Alert rules adjusted and sanity-tested in staging - [x] Unit + integration tests for metrics export - [x] Documentation updates (telemetry/README) Deployment notes: dashboards and alert rules are staged to the observability/staging namespace and will be promoted to prod after 48h of monitoring. No runtime code path changes that alter model scoring logic. Contact: @Maya for rollout windows and validation steps.
commits: feat(metrics): expose kv_cache_hit_count, kv_cache_miss_count, kv_cache_bypass_count; feat(metrics): add token_level_token_cost_gauge and token_level_latency_histogram; refactor(logging): include request_id and route/model tags in runtime logger; feat(dashboards): add token_kv_cost_latency_dashboard.json; chore(alerts): tune token-latency p95/p99 thresholds and add sustained-window condition; test(obs): add integration test for KV metrics and dashboard templating
